boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Swarthmore College
boards.description: Ten distinct, under-21-safe evening food destinations with currently posted hours.

cards.title: Crumb Cafe
cards.subtitle: Dining and Community Commons, Swarthmore College
cards.notes: Go between 8 and 11 p.m. when campus is in session; confirm break-period availability before relying on this student-run food stop.
cards.short_summary: A campus-based evening food option in the Dining and Community Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: SwatStories reports that Crumb Cafe operates daily from 8–11 p.m., except during breaks, and is located in the Dining Community Commons.
cards.source_title: Crumb Cafe: Swarthmore’s Only Student-Run Dining Spot
cards.access_notes: Reported hours are 8–11 p.m. daily except during academic breaks; check for break or event changes.

cards.title: Swarthmore Pizza
cards.subtitle: 601 S. Chester Road, Swarthmore
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday window for an evening pickup or delivery order; the dining room closes one hour before the listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza option with later Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Pizza lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and says delivery begins at 4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday listed until 10 p.m.; dining room closes one hour before closing, and last seating is 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Luna's Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: 6 Park Avenue, Swarthmore
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner pickup before the 11 p.m. close, and check the restaurant’s site for any schedule updates.
cards.short_summary: Park Avenue restaurant with late Friday and Saturday dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Luna's Mexican Grill lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. at 6 Park Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Listed Friday and Saturday hours run to 11 p.m.; Tuesday–Thursday hours run to 9 p.m.

cards.title: Nifty Fifty's Ridley Township
cards.subtitle: 1900 MacDade Boulevard, Folsom
cards.notes: For the latest listed option, go Friday or Saturday before midnight; use the official location page to confirm holiday-hour changes.
cards.short_summary: A Folsom diner with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Nifty Fifty's lists its Ridley Township location as open Friday and Saturday from 6 a.m. to 12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed Sunday–Thursday hours end at 10 p.m.; Friday and Saturday hours end at midnight.

cards.title: Dunkin' on Chester Road
cards.subtitle: 1 S. Chester Road, Swarthmore
cards.notes: Make this an early-evening stop: the official locator lists a 9 p.m. close every day, with mobile ordering among the location features.
cards.short_summary: A daily evening coffee, donut, and sandwich stop at the edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin's official location page lists daily hours of 5 a.m.–9 p.m. for 1 S. Chester Road in Swarthmore.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 1 S Chester Rd in Swarthmore
cards.access_notes: Listed open daily until 9 p.m.; the official page notes mobile ordering, though store participation may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell / KFC on West Sproul Road
cards.subtitle: 835 West Sproul Road, Springfield
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or dine-in before the posted close; Thursday through Saturday are listed later than the other nights.
cards.short_summary: A Springfield fast-food destination with 11 p.m. late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Springfield location's drive-thru hours through 11 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell / KFC at 835 West Sproul Rd, Springfield
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours end at 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and 10:30 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday.

cards.title: Broad Table Tavern
cards.subtitle: The Inn at Swarthmore, 10 Chester Road
cards.notes: For an evening meal, arrive during the listed dinner period and verify availability directly; this card refers to restaurant dining, not bar service.
cards.short_summary: An Inn at Swarthmore restaurant serving dinner nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Broad Table Tavern lists dinner hours of 4–9 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner is listed daily from 4–9 p.m. This recommendation is for the restaurant's food service only.

cards.title: Aria Mediterranean Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 405 Dartmouth Avenue, Swarthmore
cards.notes: Place a dinner or pickup order before the listed 8 p.m. close; service is not offered Sunday or Monday according to the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Dartmouth Avenue Mediterranean dinner option with weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Aria Mediterranean lists service until 8 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday at 405 Dartmouth Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Tuesday 4–8 p.m.; Wednesday–Friday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 3–8 p.m.; closed Sunday–Monday.

cards.title: Bamboo Bistro
cards.subtitle: 333 Dartmouth Avenue, Swarthmore
cards.notes: Schedule pickup or dinner before the stated 8:30 p.m. close; the business lists the same evening close Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Dartmouth Avenue Asian restaurant with nightly service through 8:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Bamboo Bistro's official site lists Tuesday–Saturday hours of 11:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m. and Sunday hours of noon–8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed open Tuesday–Saturday until 8:30 p.m. and Sunday until 8:30 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Wendy's on Pennell Road
cards.subtitle: 5150 Pennell Road, Media
cards.notes: If you need the latest listed food option, use this drive-thru or restaurant before midnight; confirm holiday changes on the official locator.
cards.short_summary: A Media-area Wendy's with midnight service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–12 a.m. daily at 5150 Pennell Road.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed daily until midnight; holiday hours may vary.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named Scott Arboretum & Gardens stops for an unhurried outdoor hang; the grounds are free and open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Walk the Dean Bond Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Scott Arboretum & Gardens, Swarthmore College
cards.notes: Meet by the garden entrance, take one slow loop, and use the labeled roses as prompts for a low-key conversation.
cards.short_summary: A compact rose-garden walk with plenty to notice at your own pace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scott Arboretum & Gardens grounds and gardens are free and open to the public from dawn to dusk, 365 days a year.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor grounds; visit dawn to dusk. Follow garden policies, including no picking or collecting plants.

cards.title: Take a Crum Woods trail walk
cards.subtitle: Scott Arboretum & Gardens, Swarthmore College
cards.notes: Choose a marked trail section, keep the pace conversational, and turn back before dusk so the group exits together.
cards.short_summary: A wooded, map-supported walk beside the campus arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scott Arboretum & Gardens grounds and gardens are free and open to the public from dawn to dusk, 365 days a year.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor grounds; visit dawn to dusk. Stay on marked trails and check conditions before heading into the woods.

cards.title: Pause in Wister Garden

cards.evidence_claim: The Scott Arboretum & Gardens grounds and gardens are free and open to the public from dawn to dusk, 365 days a year.

cards.title: Sit out a study break in Harry Wood Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Scott Arboretum & Gardens, Swarthmore College

cards.evidence_claim: The Scott Arboretum & Gardens grounds and gardens are free and open to the public from dawn to dusk, 365 days a year.

cards.subtitle: Scott Arboretum & Gardens, Swarthmore College

cards.evidence_claim: The Scott Arboretum & Gardens grounds and gardens are free and open to the public from dawn to dusk, 365 days a year.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Swarthmore rituals, campus events, and archival traditions—current status is noted where the evidence is historical.

cards.title: First Collection
cards.subtitle: First-year candle-lighting ceremony
cards.notes: If you are invited during orientation, arrive ready for a reflective outdoor gathering; the College places First Collection at the amphitheater.
cards.short_summary: A candle-lighting welcome that marks the beginning of a Swarthmore education.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore’s 2022–23 viewbook describes First Collection as a candle-lighting ceremony at the start of the academic year.
cards.access_notes: For the incoming class during orientation; follow current College orientation communications.

cards.title: Last Collection
cards.subtitle: Senior-class closing ceremony
cards.notes: Look for Commencement Weekend information if you are a graduating senior; recent College programs place Last Collection on the Friday before Commencement.
cards.short_summary: A senior send-off paired in name and spirit with First Collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore’s 2022 Commencement announcement states that Last Collection featured student and faculty speakers on the Friday before graduation.
cards.source_title: Unique Commencement Highlights Classes of 2022 and 2020
cards.access_notes: A Commencement Weekend event for graduating classes; confirm the current year’s schedule with the College.

cards.title: Crum Regatta
cards.subtitle: Student-built craft race on Crum Creek
cards.notes: Watch for campus announcements and view the handmade boats before the race; do not enter the creek or build a craft outside event guidance.
cards.short_summary: A long-running race featuring imaginative, student-made watercraft on the Crum.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2024 Swarthmore ITS post calls the Crum Regatta a time-honored Swarthmore boat-race tradition and documents students building creek-worthy craft.
cards.source_title: Perfect day for a boat race!
cards.access_notes: Event participation and creek access depend on current organizer and College safety guidance.

cards.title: Pterodactyl Hunt
cards.subtitle: Campus fantasy game organized by Psi Phi
cards.notes: Check Psi Phi’s current event information, then join only through the organized game and use the foam equipment and rules supplied by its organizers.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide fantasy quest combining riddles, roles, costumes, and foam-weapon play.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore Magazine describes the Pterodactyl Hunt as a 40-year-old campus tradition organized annually by Psi Phi.
cards.access_notes: Attend only when an official student-organized event is announced and follow its game rules.

cards.title: NinjaGrams
cards.subtitle: Handmade notes delivered by costumed ninjas
cards.notes: When the organizers announce sales or volunteer sign-ups, send a note or help make cards; deliveries are planned through the student-run event.
cards.short_summary: A playful message-delivery day with handmade cards, treats, and theatrical ninja entrances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Phoenix reports that NinjaGrams is a Swarthmore tradition dating to 2007, with handmade cards and costumed deliveries.
cards.source_title: NinjaGrams Return: An Old Tradition Coming Back to Life
cards.access_notes: Availability is organizer-dependent; consult current student event announcements.

cards.title: Worthstock
cards.subtitle: Spring live-music gathering in Worth Courtyard
cards.notes: Check the current student-event schedule for the lineup and location; take in the performances and listed daytime activities without assuming a fixed format.
cards.short_summary: A spring campus music tradition staged around the end of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Phoenix describes Worthstock as a Swarthmore tradition held before spring finals with live music in Worth Courtyard.
cards.access_notes: Format, performers, and access may change yearly; rely on the current College or student event notice.

cards.title: The Graduate, Before Classes
cards.subtitle: Annual pre-semester campus film screening
cards.notes: Consult the opening-week schedule for the screening location and time; this is a communal movie event, so follow the venue’s current attendance rules.
cards.short_summary: A recurring screening of the 1967 film used to open the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: The Phoenix reported in 2026 that students traditionally gather on the Sunday night before fall classes to watch The Graduate.
cards.source_title: Letter to the Editor: Swarthmore Should At Least Be Honest About Its Values
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current showing through the College’s or student organizers’ opening-week announcements.

cards.title: Garnet Day
cards.subtitle: Monthly school-spirit gathering
cards.notes: Check the month’s campus calendar, then stop by for the community gathering; the College says it is open to students, faculty, and staff.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus celebration that brings the Swarthmore community together.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore’s viewbook describes Garnet Day as a monthly school-spirit event open to all students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Monthly; consult the current campus calendar for the date and format.

cards.title: Swarthmore Folk Festival
cards.subtitle: Historical campus music tradition, 1945–mid-1970s
cards.notes: Treat this as an archives stop rather than a current event: explore its history and performers through the College’s student-media account.
cards.short_summary: An intercollegiate folk-music festival that once brought major performers to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Phoenix reports that the Swarthmore Folk Festival began in 1945 and ran as a spring-weekend tradition until the mid-1970s.
cards.access_notes: Historical and discontinued; no current event is implied.

cards.title: McCabe Mile
cards.subtitle: Historical 18-lap library-stack race
cards.notes: Read this as a historical campus custom, not a self-guided challenge; archived reporting places the event in McCabe’s basement stacks during admissions weekend.
cards.short_summary: An archival tradition of circling McCabe’s stacks eighteen times for a library-mile race.
cards.evidence_claim: A 2003 Phoenix report calls the McCabe Mile an annual event and records it as eighteen laps around McCabe’s stacks.
cards.access_notes: Historical status only; do not run in library spaces unless a current authorized event is announced.
